# sql-builder-ai-mcp

> Sql Builder Ai automation via MCP. Includes build select, build insert, explain query. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- build_select
- build_insert
- explain_query
- optimize_query_hints

## Install
```
pip install sql-builder-ai-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/sql-builder-ai-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
